detail.readme:
Shizzi

Wi-Fi, USB, and Ethernet tethering over a Shizuku-privileged test network.

Creates a test TUN interface, sets it as the preferred tethering upstream, and forwards hotspot traffic through a Go datapath. Supports IPv4 and IPv6. ## Requirements - Android 11 (API 30+), 64-bit or 32-bit ARM (arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a) - [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/) 13.6.0+ Android 13 and up work outright. On Android 11 and 12 it depends on the device's tethering module; the app checks on first launch and offers to install the module it needs. That module is 64-bit only, so a 32-bit device needs Android 13. See [compatibility](docs/android-compatibility.md). ## Install Download the APK from the [latest release](https://github.com/carlelieser/shizzi/releases/latest). ## Features - 🚀 **Unlimited hotspot.** Sharing draws on your regular data instead of your hotspot allowance. - 🛡️ **VPN compatible.** Stay private on every connected device. - ⚙️ **Uses your existing hotspot.** No extra configuration required. - 🔌 **Wired tethering.** Share over a USB cable to a computer, or over a USB-C Ethernet adapter, alongside or instead of the hotspot. Pick it under Settings → Tethering → Wired tethering; turn off Wi-Fi hotspot there to share over the cable only. See [Ethernet tethering](docs/android-compatibility.md#ethernet-tethering) for what an adapter needs. - 🙌 **No root.** Shizuku is all it needs. - 🎛️ **One tap away.** A quick settings tile starts and stops sharing from the notification shade. - 🤖 **Automatable.** Start and stop from Tasker or MacroDroid. See [automation](docs/automation.md). ## Troubleshooting **Shizuku stops when the hotspot or wired tethering turns on.** If you start Shizuku with Wireless Debugging, a network change can turn Wireless Debugging off and take Shizuku with it. Sharing resumes once Shizuku is started again. Starting Shizuku with root, or over adb in TCP mode, avoids the problem. **Connected devices bypass the VPN, or sharing won't start with VPN set to Always.** Shizzi only sees a VPN that covers every app. If your VPN app has per-app proxy or split tunneling turned on (v2rayNG and AmneziaVPN, for example), Shizzi cannot detect the VPN. Turn that setting off in the VPN app. ## Build Needs the Android SDK with NDK, Go, and gomobile: ``` go install golang.org/x/mobile/cmd/gomobile@latest && gomobile init ./gradlew assembleDebug ```
